about: Starter Library Map in the same shape as a Google Sheets values export. Paste rows 1-4 into a new sheet tab called 'Library Map', then replace the example rows. render_library_map.py reads this format.
values: Find anything we have made, said, or been part of. Each row is one kind of knowledge and the ONE place that owns it. MASTER = update it there. LENS = made by a program; never type in it. LEGACY = frozen history; read it, don't add to it. EXTERNAL MASTER = the master lives outside this sheet.
How it fits the Content Factory: recordings are Produce, transcripts and edits are Process, live pages are Post, paid boosts are Promote. Rules for agents: the 'Agent Start Here' tab.
